$comment: engine.citizens mortality-smoothing / death-wave balance configuration (FEAT-087, feat.deathwave). Every numeric value below is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass (the balance-number regime, same convention as data/fertility.json and data/census.json) — tests check direction and structure only, never a pinned magnitude. The monthly death budget bounds how many hazard-selected deaths are REALISED per non-emergency month, so a same-birthMonth cohort aging onto the steep Gompertz slope produces a smooth ~N-deaths/month tail, never a single-month population cliff (AC-1). The weather emergency is sourced from a deterministic, seeded citywide weather draw keyed (worldSeed, month, 'weather') — engine.season is the eventual source per the feat.deathwave acceptance criteria (AC-7), but the engine.citizens → engine.season code.json outbound edge is NOT yet registered, so this feature derives the signal locally (deterministic, seeded, no wall clock — GR#21) and flags that edge for the master-plan SSOT pass. FEAT-088 death services (graveyards, cremation, hearses) is the downstream handoff target of the realised-death queue.

meta.balanceRegime: Every numeric entry below is a disclosed placeholder pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass. Units are stated per entry.

monthlyDeathBudget.disclosure: placeholder — maximum hazard-selected deaths realised in a single non-emergency month (the smoothing throughput cap), pending Aaron's balance pass. Directional-only: tests assert the cap binds, never this exact figure.

weatherEmergencyThreshold.disclosure: placeholder — deterministic monthly weather severity at or above which a month is a declared weather emergency (adverse weather), pending Aaron's balance pass. Severity is drawn from hash(worldSeed, month, 'weather') in [0,1); at 0.9 roughly one month in ten is an emergency.

emergencyBudgetMultiplier.disclosure: placeholder — during a weather emergency the monthly death budget is multiplied by this to produce the documented emergency throughput (a major, non-smoothed death event), pending Aaron's balance pass. Bounded (never unbounded), so even an emergency month realises at most budget×multiplier deaths.
